filo policies
filo policies add NAME [VALUE]
filo policies set NAME VALUE [-y]
filo policies move OLD NEW [-y]
filo policies remove NAME
filo policies show NAME

  A policy is a named retention, written once and typed in the retention column
  of a retention CSV in place of a period: bills = 7y. Changing it changes every
  file using it. Its value is a period (counted from each file's own file_date),
  a date, or forever; a name typed in a CSV that is not a policy yet creates one
  with no value, after filo update asks.

  filo policies lists them, with what needs attention: no value, a date passed,
  files without a file_date. add creates one; set gives it a value or changes it
  (it asks first if files would be put past their retention, or left without a
  file_date to count from); move moves every file to another policy (into a new
  name it is a rename); remove deletes a policy no file uses; show lists its
  files.

Flags
  -y                       set and move: go ahead without asking

  A file kept until 2026-12-31 is past its retention on 2026-12-31: it is listed
  by the next filo delete, which asks before deleting anything.
